parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1697669 (Cadherin-2) that have exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
